name: MIKITYPE
introduction: MIKITYPE is a Japanese calligrapher. He was born in 1992 in Sapporo and graduated from the Department of Design Informatics at Musashino Art University in 2015. He learned calligraphy from a master Minako Sando while in university. His works consist of editorials of international and domestic magazines, Sacai AW 2016 at Paris Fashion Week, N.Hoolywood SS 2016 at New York Fashion Week Men's, Vans, United Arrows, Jiyugaoka's Maison Iéna , TV Tokyo's The World Table Tennis 2015, The Tours of J Soul Brothers Third from Exile Tribe, and The Pool Aoyama Fragment Design x N.Hoolywood.
